meta.title: FDP-1 Spatial Systems V3: scenario-only collision-protection parameters (P11)
meta.note: Scenario inputs, not FDP-1 or IGNITION canon. Every value names its source and status. Nothing here is written back to data/fdp1_parameters.json, data/requirements.json or data/wayfarer_3d.toml.
meta.frame: metres; +X bow; particles arrive from +X (opposite the velocity), travelling -X relative to the ship

shield.geometry_source: data/ship_geometry.json parts WF_Shield_Rim, WF_Shield_Skin, WF_Disruptor_Layer_01 (Wayfarer baseline, moved +122.4 m by the FDP-1 T-B bow shift)
shield.stack_ref: data/wayfarer_3d.toml forward_shield.stack: thickness, material stack and mass OPEN (OD-014); the 100 t Brow mass is PROVISIONAL and not valid for the 90 m shield

radiator_shadow_margin_m.ref: forward_shield.radiator_shadow_margin, zero angle of attack; attitude envelope OPEN (OD-015)

shadow_rule.value: At nominal high-speed attitude, occupied rings and vulnerable radiator surfaces remain inside the projected forward-shield silhouette.

aligned_stream.note: idealized parallel stream along -X (the brief's first-order model)

shadow_angle_diagnostic.note: forward_defense.shadow_angle: geometry of the 8 m radiator margin over 200 m; not an operational attitude limit (OD-015)

seam_arrival_cone_prototype.note: forward_shield.bumper_facing.seam_arrival_cone_deg: the design arrival cone of the bumper seam screen

defaults_notes.safety_margin_m: scenario choice; 0 shows pure geometry. The canon 8 m radiator / 15 m ring margins are offered as presets
defaults_notes.uncertainty_band_m: display assumption: clearances within this band are drawn yellow (uncertain)
defaults_notes.areal_density_kg_m2: UNKNOWN (OD-014). null keeps shield-mass feedback UNRESOLVED; any number entered is a labelled ASSUMPTION
defaults_notes.engine_radius_exponent: 0 = engine geometry does not change with power (no documented scaling law). 1/3 or 1/2 are labelled hypothetical packaging laws

component_classes.CRITICAL: non-sacrificial, mission-critical; must sit inside the protection envelope or have an independently justified protection
component_classes.RADIATOR: assessed separately (planform, frontal area, exposure); survivability class UNKNOWN in the record
component_classes.SHIELD: the protective system itself (shield, disruptor, Crown, EYE wells): not assessed against its own shadow
